name: aws-diagram-design
description: Finished, presentation-ready AWS diagram images (HTML/SVG/PNG) to embed in docs and slides — a rendered picture, not an editable draw.io file (for that, use aws-drawio-diagram). Amazon Ember typography, squid ink + smile orange skin, official AWS Architecture Icons bundled. 27 visual types, draw.io and Mermaid import. Includes a Python generator (scripts/pygen) that renders spec files to bilingual (ko/en) HTML and PNG sets in the same house style.
